Safety
Peace of mind for the
driver and all inside.
Toyota’s Star Safety System™ is a suite of six safety features offered standard on every new Toyota. The system includes
Vehicle Stability Control (VSC),1 Traction Control (TRAC), Anti-lock Brake System (ABS), Electronic Brake-force Distribution
(EBD), Brake Assist (BA),2 and Smart Stop Technology® (SST).3 Termed “active” safety features, they’re designed to operate
in certain situations to help prevent accidents from occurring in the first place.
VEHICLE STABILITY CONTROL (VSC)1 ELECTRONIC BRAKE-FORCE DISTRIBUTION (EBD)
VSC helps prevent sideslip or skidding that can cause drivers to lose control EBD helps keep the vehicle balanced when braking. During sudden stops, forward
during cornering. VSC monitors your steering angle and compares it to the momentum causes the vehicle to tilt forward, reducing the brake effectiveness
direction in which your vehicle is actually traveling. If VSC detects a loss of traction of the rear wheels. EBD responds by redistributing brake force from wheels with
in a turn, engine output is reduced and/or brake force is applied to individual less braking effectiveness to wheels with more effectiveness. This helps prevent
wheels as needed. brake lockup. EBD is especially helpful when you’re carrying cargo. When sensors
detect extra load on the rear axle, brake pressure on the rear wheels is increased,
TRACTION CONTROL (TRAC)
exploiting the improved braking effectiveness extra weight can provide.
TRAC helps to maintain traction on wet, icy, loose or uneven surfaces. Like VSC,
TRAC applies braking individually and reduces engine output to help assist the BRAKE ASSIST (BA)2
driver with control of the vehicle. In emergency braking situations, a driver can fail to apply enough pressure to
the brake pedal. BA can detect sudden or “panic” braking and apply additional
4-WHEEL ANTI-LOCK BRAKE SYSTEM (ABS)
brake pressure, taking full advantage of ABS and helping prevent a collision.
ABS helps ensure that you’re able to continue steering during emergency braking.
By “pulsing” the brake of each wheel more rapidly than would be humanly SMART STOP TECHNOLOGY® (SST)3
possible, ABS helps keep the brakes from locking up. Since the system repeatedly At speeds greater than five miles per hour, when the accelerator is depressed first
releases the brakes for fractions of a second, the wheels never stop rotating, and the brakes are then applied firmly for longer than one-half second, SST is
which helps keep the vehicle from going into a skid. designed to help the driver bring the vehicle to a stop.
EIGHT AIRBAGS4
Tundra also comes equipped with driver and front outboard passenger airbags,
side curtain and front seat-mounted side airbags. Additionally, driver and front
outboard passenger knee airbags are standard equipment.
